criteria.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section
criteria.final_justification: Action history indicates the agent intended to reach a Best sellers list, but the screenshot evidence does not visually confirm that a “Best sellers” section was found or viewed. There is also no uncontrollable blocker shown preventing access. Therefore the baseline full score is not supported by evidence; award partial credit for reasonable attempt/navigation to the Games area but not confirming the Best sellers section.

criteria.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'
criteria.final_justification: The agent did open a valid product page on Xbox.com (confirmed). But because the evidence does not confirm the game was selected from a “Best sellers” section, reduce from full to partial credit (product page opened, best-sellers origin unverified).

criteria.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
criteria.final_justification: All required fields were available on the page, but the agent’s final output omitted the publisher and asserted it could not be verified—contradicted by Screenshot 7. This is a controllable extraction/reporting failure (not a blocker). Award partial credit reflecting that 2 of 3 fields were correctly reported.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear respected: no sign-in and no purchase/download initiated or completed. The agent stopped after attempting to record details (even though incomplete). No evidence of violating constraints, so keep full credit.
